description:
List the S&P 500 stocks that match a setup at the latest daily close (e.g. "what broke out today on volume").

    rule: a formula in Trade Manager's language, e.g. "close > prev_high and volume > volume_avg * 1.5".
    limit: max stocks to return (default 25). Stocks where the rule just turned true come first,
    then by volume vs their 20-day average. Uses end-of-day data, not live prices.
name: scan_today
